subject.title: feat(ios): og:image thumbnails on link preview cards

question: Should remote OpenGraph thumbnails be allowed to fetch page-controlled cross-host image URLs under the current post-request URLSession metrics guard, or must image fetches be narrowed to a pre-request or pinned public-address boundary before merge?
rationale: The PR changes a security boundary by adding a second network request and untrusted ImageIO decode path from chat content; automation should not decide whether that expanded remote-fetch policy is acceptable.

options.title: Narrow the image boundary before merge
options.body: Require the image request to be blocked or pinned before any private-network GET can start, and keep the MIME allowlist aligned with the approved JPEG/PNG/WebP policy.

options.title: Accept the expanded boundary explicitly
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept post-request guarding and GIF support, but the PR should document that decision and add matching proof before landing.

options.title: Pause remote thumbnails
options.body: Keep the shipped Apple text-preview cards while the remote-image privacy and security contract is redesigned.

recommendation.title: Narrow the image boundary before merge
recommendation.body: Require the image request to be blocked or pinned before any private-network GET can start, and keep the MIME allowlist aligned with the approved JPEG/PNG/WebP policy.
